role_title: Wildland fire intelligence and data analyst
description: DOI's SO 3448 directs an integrated wildland fire intelligence and data capability in the new USWFS; existing NWCG positions are incident-bound and no accredited fire-intelligence pipeline exists.
Operators increasingly run processes from sensor and control-system data; apprenticeship and mentor programs are expanding with EPA funding, but EMST has no treatment-operations competency.

Performance-based formation depends on qualified evaluators and mentors at the moment public-land agency staffing fell by double-digit percentages in several western states (reported); evaluator capacity, not course seats, may become the binding constraint on pathways.

role_title: Federal biologists moving to state agencies and consulting
description: Federal staffing reductions push experienced biologists toward state and consulting roles, where business development, applicant-side permitting and mitigation-market skills are needed (LC-PW-04). Flow data not found; CM to test with career histories.
Training staff will need to design AI-assisted practice and assessment while protecting formation; no environmental-sector evidence found this session.
